title: The Secret Life of Soil
excerpt: In this episode, Henning shares his incredible journey from post-war Germany to becoming a pioneering biodynamic farmer in the United States. Learn about the intricate relationships between plants, soil bacteria, and our immune systems. Explore the visionary ideas of Rudolf Steiner and how they continue to influence modern agriculture. Henning also discusses the challenges and rewards of sustainable farming and the importance of nurturing our soil for a healthier future.

In this episode, Henning shares his incredible journey from post-war Germany to becoming a pioneering biodynamic farmer in the United States. Learn about the intricate relationships between plants, soil bacteria, and our immune systems. Explore the visionary ideas of Rudolf Steiner and how they continue to influence modern agriculture. Henning also discusses the challenges and rewards of sustainable farming and the importance of nurturing our soil for a healthier future.

Don't miss this fascinating conversation that connects the dots between soil health, nutrition, and our mental and physical well-being. Tune in to find out how you can become a part of this transformative movement.
